purpose: The KYC service allows customers to complete identity verification in the app without visiting a branch, by sending identity data and photos to an external vendor for verification.

components.name: kyc-orchestrator
components.evidence: kyc-orchestrator is the heart of the system, it keep the cases in kyc-db (PostgreSQL) and the pictures in the bucket kyc-documents (S3).

components.name: kyc-db
components.evidence: Database kyc-db keep the cases and the history of every status.

components.name: kyc-documents
components.evidence: The bucket kyc-documents has the versions of the objects switched on.

components.name: Identity verification vendor
components.evidence: kyc-orchestrator call the Identity verification vendor and wait for the answer, the vendor answer later and not in the same request.

flows.data: identity data and photo of identity document
